newReleases.desc:
Tideward is a premium idle RPG built for iPhone and iPad, and the rest of the Apple ecosystem you already own. Train 28 skills at your own pace, fight monsters, craft your own gear, and grow stronger even while you sleep.

No ads. No tracking. No third-party SDKs. One purchase, every device.


· TRUE OFFLINE PROGRESSION ·

Close the app and live your life. Tideward gives you up to 24 hours of full-speed progress every time you return, with no throttle and no penalty for having been away. No "watch an ad to claim." No daily-login guilt. Your character keeps working while you don't.


· CAN YOU LEAVE IT RUNNING? ·

It runs the same code that resolves the real offline fight. Elsewhere in this genre that answer comes from a simulator you install yourself.


· 28 SKILLS, FOUR DISCIPLINES ·

Combat: Attack, Strength, Defense, Vitality, Ranged, Magic, Vigil, Quarry. Gathering: Beachcombing, Farming, Fishing, Hearth, Mining, Pilfering, Woodcutting. Artisan: Apothecary, Bowcraft, Cooking, Forging, Handicraft, Inscription, Kindling, Scrimshaw, Shipwrighting. Wayfaring: Binding, Chartwork, Stargazing, Wayfaring. Every system feeds the others. Mine ore, smelt it into bars, forge a blade, take it into a dungeon. The depth of an MMO at the patience of an idle game.


· NATIVE ON EVERY APPLE DEVICE ·

Built in pure

newReleases.name: Fickle Allies
newReleases.desc:
Fickle Allies is an online horror game for five to eight players. Everyone starts as a stranger in the dark. Collect the crystals scattered through the map, carry them to the safe area, and survive until the match ends.

Trust is the whole game. Form a group and its members cannot kill each other. Leave it and they can hunt you. Steal from a carrier and you take everything they hold. Sneak up behind a player and hold to kill them, but if they turn round first, you are the one locked out.

Three maps: the Weird Mansion, the Abandoned Subway and the Abandoned Facility, each with its own floors, stairs and hiding places. Your helmet lamp lights the way and gives you away.

Private Mode lets you play with friends and attach scares to crystals. Whoever collects a trapped crystal gets scared when you choose.

Free to try with two Practice and two Public matches. Full Game Access is a one-time purchase for unlimited matches, all maps and all modes.

Winter Burrow is a survival game you play at your own pace. Customize your character, decorate your burrow and choose a path that fits your play style. This story is yours to tell.

newReleases.name: Fivefold - Logic Puzzles
newReleases.desc:
Fivefold is a Sudoku-inspired game where the rules change every puzzle. Fill the grid through pure deduction, combining familiar number-placement logic with new rules. It's a game that will never stop giving you those satisfying "Aha!" moments.

Enjoy the daily puzzle with your morning coffee, or play a quick, easy puzzle while you're waiting for an appointment. When you're ready, you can move to harder puzzles, like our large 7x7 puzzles that'll give your brain a real workout.

We kept Fivefold simple. There are no ads interrupting you, no in-game currencies, and no tricks to keep you playing. The game comes with a ton of free puzzles, and if you want even more, you can buy a puzzle pack. That’s it!

We made Fivefold because we love puzzles too. We hope it makes your brain work just a little bit harder, and we hope that you'll enjoy playing it as much as we enjoyed making it!

- Matt & Owen
